implemented_requirements.evidence: No narrative text or segment definitions are present in the supplied files.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Branching choices based on player decisions
implemented_requirements.evidence: The files contain only isolated JSON condition examples; there is no code that presents choices or links them to story nodes.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Track variables such as relationships or items
implemented_requirements.evidence: Only a handful of condition templates are listed; there is no state‑management code, no variable storage, and no logic that updates relationships or inventory.
The JSON snippets describe possible condition types but are not integrated into any engine or story flow.

implemented_requirements.require: Store branches in a structured way
implemented_requirements.evidence: No data structures (e.g., dictionaries, classes, or files) representing story nodes or branches are defined.
engine.py contains only the placeholder text "FILENAME" and no runnable code.

critical_issues: engine.py lacks any implementation; it does not define a game loop, input handling, or story rendering.
story_data.py only lists example condition objects; there is no actual story graph, dialogue, or branching data.
No mechanism for tracking player state (items, relationships, flags, variables) is present.
No conditional evaluation logic exists to apply the listed condition types to affect story progression.
The project cannot be executed as‑is; there is no entry point or runnable script.
judge.summary: The submitted files do not contain a functional interactive storytelling engine or any concrete story data. Only placeholder text and isolated JSON condition examples are provided, which is insufficient to meet any of the benchmark requirements. Consequently, the submission fails both functional completeness and executability criteria.
